name: Cibinetide (ARA-290)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Cibinetide (ARA-290) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 10 mg, 16 mg, 40 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Cibinetide (ARA-290) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Cibinetide (ARA-290) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the ARA certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 1208243-50-8, formula C51H84N16O21, 1257.31 Da).

faq.question: How should Cibinetide (ARA-290) be stored?
faq.answer: Cibinetide (ARA-290) ships lyophilized and should stay at −20 °C until reconstitution; after that keep it at 2–8 °C and avoid freeze–thaw cycles.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Cibinetide (ARA-290)?
faq.answer: Cibinetide (ARA-290) is stocked in 3 pack sizes (10 mg, 16 mg, 40 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $78.84; 10–49 kits falls to $72.54 (−8%) and 50+ to $67.02 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
